verses: Sabit honey wali
Sabit honey wali kiya hai?
Aur tujhay kiya maloom hai kay woh sabit shuda kiya hai?
Uss khrka denay wali ko samood aur aad ney jhutla diya tha
(jiss kay nateeja mein) samood to bey hadd khufnak (aur unchi) awaz say halak kerdiye gaye
Aur aad behad tez tund hua say ghaarat kerdiye gaye
Jissay unn per lagataar saat raat aur aath din tak (Allah ney) musallat rakha pus tum dekhtay kay yeh log zamin per uss tarah gir gaye jaisay kay khajoor kay khokhly tanay hun
Kiya unn mein say koi bhi tujhay baqi nazar aaraha hai?
Firaun aur uss say pehlay kay log aur jin ki bastiyan ulat di gaee, unhon ney bhi khatayen kin
Aur apney rab kay rasool ki na-farmani ki (bil-aakhir) Allah ney unhen (bhi) zabardast girift mein ley liya
Jab pani mein tughyani aagaee to uss waqt hum ney tumhen kashti mein charha liya
Takay ussay tumharay liye naseehat aur yaadgar banadein, aur (takay) yaad rakhney walay kaan ussay yaad rakhen
Pus jab kay soor mein aik phoonk phonki jaye gi
Aur zamin aur pahar utha liye jayen gay aur aik hi chot mein reza reza ker diye jayen gay
Uss din ho parney wali (qayamat) ho paray gi
Aur aasman phat jaye ga aur uss din bilkul boda hojaye ga
Uss kay kinaron per farishtay hun gay, aur teray perwerdigar ka arsh uss din aath (farishtay) apney upper uthaye huye hun gay
Uss din tum sab samney paish kiye jao gay, tumhara koi bhed posheedah na rahey ga
So jissay uss ka nama aemaal uss kay dayen hath mein diya jaye ga to woh kehney lagay ga kay lo mera nama aemaal parho
Mujhay to kamil yaqeen tha kay mujhay apna hisab milna hai
Pus woh aik dil pasand zindagi mein hoga
Buland bala jannat mein
Jiss kay meway jhukay paray hun gay
(unn say kaha jaye ga) kay mazay say khao, piyo apney unn aemaal kay badlay jo tum ney guzishta zamaney mein kiye
Lekin jissay uss (kay aemaal) ki kitab uss kay bayen hath mein di jaye gi, woh to kahey ga kay kaash kay mujhay meri kitab di hi na jati
Aur mein janta hi na kay hisab kiya hai
Kaash! kay maut (mera) kaam hi tamam ker deti
Meray maal ney bhi mujhay kuch nafa na diya
Mera ghalba bhi mujh say jata raha
(hukum hoga) ussay pakar lo phir ussay toq phyna
Phir ussay dozakh mein daal do
Phir ussay aisi zanjeer mein jiss ki paymaish satter hath ki hai jaker do
Be-shak yeh Allah azmat walay per eman na rakhta tha
Aur miskeen kay khilaney per raghbat na dilata tha
Pus aaj uss ka na koi dost hai
Aur na siwaye peep kay uss ki koi ghiza hai
Jissay gunah gaaron kay siwa koi nahi khaye ga
Pus mujhay qasam hai unn cheezon ki jinhen tum dekhtay ho
Aur unn cheezon ki jinhen tum nahi dekhtay
Kay be-shak yeh (Quran) buzurg rasool ka qol hai
Yeh kissi shaeer ka qol nahi (afsos) tumhen boht kum yaqeen hai
Aur na kissi kaahin ka qol hai, (afsos) boht kum naseehat ley rahey ho
(yeh to) rab aalameen ka utara hua hai
Aur agar yeh hum per koi bhi baat bana leta
To albatta hum uss ka dahana hath pakar letay
Phir uss ki shah sheyrag kaat detay
Phir tum mein say koi bhi mujhay uss say rokney wala na hota
Yaqeenan yeh Quran perhezgaron kay liye naseehat hai
Humen poori tarah maloom hai kay tum mein say baaz uss kay jhutlanay walay hain
Be-shak (yeh jhutlan)kafiron) kafiron per hasrat hai
Aur be-shak (o shuba)yeh) yeh yaqeeni haq hai
Pus to apney rab azeem ki paki biyan ker
